reference_conversion: Original SVGs rasterized to PNG using nearest-neighbor scaling, without modifying the source SVGs.
review: Composition, landscape setting and three distinct characters are present. Generated sprite outlines and markings are interpreted, not pixel-identical to the original SVGs. Treat this as a visual-direction preview; exact original sprite fidelity needs correction before final video use.
recommended_next_step: Choose the visual direction, prepare exact-character keyframes, then use Flow Gemini Omni Flash 1.1 image-to-video. Original character references may additionally support identity when the selected Flow mode permits them.
